Rajasthan Civic Polls: Violence Erupts During Nomination Filing

During the nomination process for Rajasthan's civic body elections, an attack occurred outside the SDM office in Fatehpur, Sikar. Masked assailants targeted Congress candidates and supporters, resulting in injuries. Reports indicate six people were injured, with two referred to Sikar hospital. The incident led to a political clash amid the elections. In a separate development within the same region, some voters in areas considered strongholds of Sachin Pilot boycotted the elections.
